item.title: Prior named NCBWA DII National Pitcher of the Week
item.description: Georgia College & State University’s Keaton Prior has been named the National Collegiate Baseball Writers Association NCAA Division II National Pitcher of the Week ending March 2.

item.title: BCSD Distinguished Alumni: Justice Hugh Thompson Class of 1961
item.description: When Baldwin High School opened in 1956, it marked a major shift in Milledgeville’s educational landscape. Justice Hugh Thompson entered a school still defining its identity and graduated in 1961 as part of the earliest wave of Baldwin Braves.

item.title: Schubert named corporate VP, Baldwin Co. Market President of Citizens Bank of the South
item.description: Lynde Schubert has been named corporate vice president, Baldwin County Market president of Citizens Bank of the South.

item.title: BCSD Distinguished Alumni: Dr. Kristy Cuthbert Class of 2001
item.description: When Dr. Kristy Cuthbert graduated from Baldwin High School in 2001, college did not feel inevitable.

item.title: Eatonton man arrested on child exploitation charges
item.description: A Putnam County man was recently arrested on multiple counts of sexual exploitation of children, state law enforcement authorities say.

item.title: CHANCEY: Walking is good visual of our spiritual health
item.description: A group of Buddhists monks spent 108 days walking on a 2,000-mile march from Fort Worth, Texas, to Washington, D.C. The “Walk for Peace” began Oct. 26, 2025, and completed Feb. 10. Their journey went viral, capturing the fascination of millions of Americans who were curious about their effort to promote compassion.

item.title: Man wanted for armed robbery arrested
item.description: A Milledgeville man sought for armed robbery and other criminal charges for more than two months was arrested last week in Baldwin County, local authorities say.

item.title: Barnes seeks Council requests for ArtHealthy Festival
item.description: ArtHealthy Festival organizer Gregory Barnes is seeking city support for the annual event.

item.title: Architectural design for library approved
item.description: Once completed, it will be known as the Collins P. Lee Memorial Library, where children and adults can go and read books and conduct research.

item.title: EMA Director: Small tornado may have hit Baldwin Co.
item.description: A small tornado may have touched down in parts of Milledgeville and Baldwin County Thursday morning, The Union-Recorder has learned.
